description: Source of truth for Agent App API routes that a muxsh-family Node CLI binds to. Checked, on the Rust side, against the real rpc_types struct's serde field names (agentmux-srv/src/backend/rpc_types/block.rs's CommandPaneOpenData/PaneOpenResult, test in that same file), and, on the Node side, against what each muxsh subcommand's buildRequestBody() actually emits (muxsh.contract.test.mjs). A route entry here is a claim: 'this is the real, current field set' — both tests fail if either side drifts from it.
